lines: Here the fitting meditation: that self-luminous
supreme tattva, contained in all tattvas —
meditate it in the knowledge of your own heart,
then meditate the union of knower, instrument
and known, the fire-sun-moon triad, until you
become the great Bhairava-fire, fanned by the
meditation-wind. From that wheel wrapped in
twelve old power-flames, out through some pore-door,
contemplate it resting outside in the graspable self;
and by that rested one, first fill the external
with moon-form in creation's order, then light it
with sun-form in preservation, then dissolve it
in the fire of dissolution, then cause it
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra dhyānaṃ tāvat iha ucitam upadekṣyāmaḥ yat etat svaprakāśaṃ sarvatattvāntarbhūtaṃ paraṃ tattvam uktaṃ tad eva nijahṛdayabodhe dhyātvā tatra pramātṛpramāṇaprameyarūpasya vahnyarkasomatritayasya saṃghaṭṭaṃ dhyāyet yāvat asau mahābhairavāgniḥ dhyānavātasamiddhākāraḥ sampadyate tasya prāktanaśaktijvālādvādaśakaparivṛtasya cakrātmanaḥ cakṣurādīnām anyatamasuṣiradvāreṇa niḥsṛtasya bāhye grāhyātmani viśrāntaṃ cintayet tena ca viśrāntena prathamaṃ tadbāhyaṃ somarūpatayā sṛṣṭikrameṇa prapūritaṃ tataḥ arkarūpatayā sthityā avabhāsitaṃ tato 'pi saṃhāravahnirūpatayā vilāpitaṃ tataḥ anuttarātmatām āpāditaṃ dhyāyet

reads_against.argmap: What is the dhyāna taught here? → The dhyāna is triadic-union plus four-stage cosmic filling — meditation ends where anuttara-selfhood is caused.
c1_essence: Fitting meditation: self-luminous supreme tattva in own-heart → knower-instrument-known union as fire-sun-moon → great Bhairava-fire → wheel-emergent rests external → four-fillings moon/sun/fire/anuttara.
